children: Independent Bitcoin miners mined 36 blocks between February 11 and November 7, 2026. According to PANews, Soloblocks.io data cited by Bitcoin.com News shows the blocks generated about 113.149 BTC in total, including transaction fees, with rewards of roughly 3.13 to 3.2 BTC per block. Recent finds included miners using solo pools such as CKPool Solo, with some cases involving small home mining rigs.

title: Independent Bitcoin Miners Mine 36 Blocks in 2026
